_comment: Round 4 (LLM analyst proposal, verified by the engine). Round 3 plus two changes read off its residuals: (a) every search variant measures the first model on all quotes (plain_first false): the engine's 'plain' reference is the most common customer class, which here is the account customers (口座) whose prices carry customer rates 0.8-1.0, while the list price is the one-off customers' (諸口); in round 3 the plain_first=false variant reproduced 126 quotes against 88-109 for the others; (b) the explicit feature ceil(area_m2, 0.1) * qty is withdrawn: next to the config's area_m2 * qty it is nearly collinear (fits came out as -12000 x area + 13000 x rounded area), and the engine already tries rounding-up variants of area_m2 per piece itself. Everything else as in round 3 (site text normalised, site_town emptied, height_mm only for letters, threshold flags for remark conditions, billed-area tiers, board yield, eyelets, work_budget 240 G).

derived.removal: if_(contains(remarks, '撤去') and not contains(remarks, '撤去は別途'), 1, 0)
derived.disposal: if_(contains(remarks, '処分', '産廃') and not contains(remarks, '処分不要', '処分は先方'), 1, 0)
derived.survey: if_(contains(remarks, '現調', '現地調査') and not contains(remarks, '不要'), 1, 0)
derived.no_eyelets: if_(contains(remarks, 'ハトメ不要', 'ハトメなし'), 1, 0)
derived.yield36: max(floor(910 / short_mm) * floor(1820 / long_mm), floor(910 / long_mm) * floor(1820 / short_mm))
derived.yield48: max(floor(1220 / short_mm) * floor(2440 / long_mm), floor(1220 / long_mm) * floor(2440 / short_mm))
derived.eyelets: if_((media == 'ターポリン') and (no_eyelets == 0), 2 * (ceil(width_mm / 500) + ceil(height_mm / 500)) * qty, 0)
derived.site: if_(contains(site, '浜松市'), concat('浜松市', regex(site, '区(.+)$', 1, '')), regex(site, '^\s*((?:東京都|北海道|(?:京都|大阪)府|.{2,3}?県)?.+?[市区町村])', 1, ''))
